warrior.name: Warrior
warrior.description: A battle-hardened fighter who excels at melee combat and absorbing punishment. High STR and DEF, generous HP pool.

mage.name: Mage
mage.description: A scholarly spellcaster who channels arcane forces into devastating attacks. High INT and MP, fragile body.

rogue.name: Rogue
rogue.description: A swift and cunning opportunist who strikes from the shadows. High AGI and LCK, balanced survivability.

cleric.name: Cleric
cleric.description: A divine healer who balances restorative magic with solid defence. High INT and DEF, excellent support.

samurai.name: Samurai
samurai.description: A disciplined warrior of the blade whose strikes carry the weight of honour. High STR and AGI with sharp burst damage.

knight.name: Knight
knight.description: An armoured crusader who can absorb punishment others cannot survive. Highest DEF in the game, strong STR, low AGI.

duelist.name: Duelist
duelist.description: A fencer who turns speed into lethality. Exceptional AGI and LCK, devastating on crits, paper-thin armour.

berserker.name: Berserker
berserker.description: A fury-driven brawler who trades defence for raw destruction. Highest STR in the game, almost no DEF.

assassin.name: Assassin
assassin.description: A shadow operative who poisons, blinds, and executes. High AGI and LCK with devastating single-target burst.
